records.name: Free Civil Legal Aid - Texas RioGrande Legal Aid
records.description_en: Free lawyers for civil (not criminal) problems like eviction, divorce and custody, family violence, public benefits, consumer fraud, wills, and job problems.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people who live in one of the 68 Southwest and Central Texas counties TRLA serves.
records.how_to_apply: Call the TRLA intake line at (956) 996-8752 or toll-free (833) 329-8752 on weekdays.
records.hours: Applications by phone Monday-Friday, 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. Central
records.notes: Toll-free intake (833) 329-8752. Mercedes is the administrative office only (no attorneys or intake there). Local offices: Alpine, Austin, Brownsville, Corpus Christi, Del Rio, Eagle Pass, Edinburg, El Paso, Harlingen, Kerrville, Laredo, San Antonio, Sinton, Uvalde, Victoria. Civil cases only. Family-law-only intake days could not be confirmed and were removed.
records.description_es: Abogados gratis para problemas civiles (no penales), como desalojos, divorcio y custodia, violencia familiar, beneficios públicos, fraude al consumidor, testamentos y problemas en el trabajo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos que viven en uno de los 68 condados del suroeste y centro de Texas que atiende TRLA.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de admisión de TRLA al (956) 996-8752 o gratis al (833) 329-8752, de lunes a viernes.

records.name: Austin Tenants Council
records.description_en: Free help for renters with landlord problems, repairs, tenant rights, and housing discrimination, including mediation and self-help forms.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For tenants in and around Austin. Advocates can explain your rights but are not lawyers.
records.how_to_apply: Call (512) 474-1961 during business hours to set up an appointment, or fill out the online intake form in English or Spanish on the TRLA Austin Tenants Council page.
records.hours: Monday-Thursday 9 a.m.-12 p.m. and 1 p.m.-4 p.m.; Friday 9 a.m.-12 p.m.
records.notes: Fair housing and landlord-tenant counseling. Advocates are not attorneys and cannot give legal advice; they can refer to TRLA for legal help.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para inquilinos con problemas con el dueño, reparaciones, derechos del inquilino y discriminación en la vivienda. También ofrecen mediación y formularios para hacer trámites usted mismo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inquilinos en Austin y sus alrededores. Los consejeros le pueden explicar sus derechos, pero no son abogados.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (512) 474-1961 en horario de oficina para hacer una cita, o llene el formulario en internet, en inglés o español, en la página del Austin Tenants Council de TRLA.

records.name: Texas Foster Youth Justice Project
records.description_en: Free legal help for current and former foster youth, such as getting CPS records, clearing juvenile or criminal records, and getting foster care transition benefits.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For current and former foster youth anywhere in Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Call (877) 313-3688 or TRLA intake at (956) 996-8752 to apply.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis para jóvenes que están o estuvieron en cuidado de crianza (foster care). Por ejemplo, para conseguir sus expedientes de CPS, borrar antecedentes juveniles o penales y recibir beneficios para la transición a la vida independiente.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para jóvenes que están o estuvieron en cuidado de crianza (foster care), en cualquier parte de Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (877) 313-3688 o a la línea de admisión de TRLA al (956) 996-8752 para solicitar ayuda.

records.name: Survivor's Rights Program (LASSA and The Shelter Project)
records.description_en: Free, trauma-informed legal help for survivors of sexual assault, domestic violence, or stalking, in partnership with rape crisis centers and shelters.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For survivors of sexual assault, domestic violence, or stalking.
records.how_to_apply: Call TRLA at (956) 996-8752, or ask your local rape crisis center or family violence shelter to connect you through The Shelter Project.
records.notes: Coverage set to TRLA's 68-county service area; the program page does not list a separate area and says it also works through partner rape crisis centers and shelters. For crisis help call the National Domestic Violence Hotline 1-800-799-7233 or 911.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis y con sensibilidad al trauma para sobrevivientes de agresión sexual, violencia doméstica o acoso (stalking), en colaboración con centros de crisis y refugios.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para sobrevivientes de agresión sexual, violencia doméstica o acoso (stalking).
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a TRLA al (956) 996-8752, o pida a su centro local de crisis por violación o refugio para violencia familiar que lo conecte por medio de The Shelter Project.

records.name: Legal Aid for Survivors of Sexual Assault (LASSA) Hotline

records.eligibility_summary_en: For survivors of sexual assault.
records.how_to_apply: Call 844-303-SAFE (7233), Option 1, on weekdays, or request a callback on the LASSA website.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. (not a 24-hour crisis line)
records.notes: Press Option 1. Not a crisis line: in an emergency call 911. Page does not state geographic limits; it is a Texas program linked from Lone Star Legal Aid.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis y confidencial para sobrevivientes de agresión sexual. Incluye órdenes de protección, privacidad y seguridad, derechos de las víctimas, asuntos de familia y problemas en la escuela o el trabajo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para sobrevivientes de agresión sexual.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 844-303-SAFE (7233), opción 1, de lunes a viernes, o pida que le devuelvan la llamada en el sitio web de LASSA.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - Abilene Office
records.description_en: Free lawyers for civil legal problems such as eviction and landlord issues, family law, family violence, and public benefits. They do not handle criminal or personal injury cases.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with low income who live in, or have a case in, a county LANWT serves. You must be a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident, with some exceptions for immigrant survivors (U/T visa or VAWA). Getting SNAP, Medicaid, SSI, WIC, or public housing may show you qualify.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online, or call the Legal Aid Line at 1-888-529-5277. If your case has a deadline or is about divorce, custody, support, visitation, or family violence, call the Abilene office at (325) 677-8591.
records.notes: Statewide Legal Aid Line: 1-888-529-5277. Landlord-tenant line: 855-548-8457. Disaster questions: 817-339-5391. Toll-free for this office: (800) 933-8591. Legal Aid Line (1-888-529-5277) hours per LANWT's online intake page: Monday, Wednesday, Thursday 9 a.m.-6:30 p.m.; Tuesday 9 a.m.-4 p.m. Pro Se Assistance office near the Taylor County Courthouse, Monday-Friday 9 a.m.-1 p.m.

records.how_to_apply: Apply online, or call the Legal Aid Line at 1-888-529-5277. If your case has a deadline or is about divorce, custody, support, visitation, or family violence, call the Wichita Falls office at (940) 723-5542.
records.notes: Statewide Legal Aid Line: 1-888-529-5277. Landlord-tenant line: 855-548-8457. Disaster questions: 817-339-5391. Toll-free for this office: (800) 926-5542. Legal Aid Line (1-888-529-5277) hours per LANWT's online intake page: Monday, Wednesday, Thursday 9 a.m.-6:30 p.m.; Tuesday 9 a.m.-4 p.m.
records.description_es: Abogados gratis para problemas legales civiles, como desalojos y problemas con el dueño, asuntos de familia, violencia familiar y beneficios públicos. No llevan casos penales ni de lesiones personales.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos que viven, o tienen un caso, en un condado que atiende LANWT. Debe ser ciudadano de EE. UU. o residente permanente legal, con algunas excepciones para inmigrantes sobrevivientes (visa U o T, o VAWA). Si recibe SNAP, Medicaid, SSI, WIC o vivienda pública, es probable que califique.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en internet o llame a la Línea de Ayuda Legal al 1-888-529-5277. Si su caso tiene una fecha límite o es sobre divorcio, custodia, manutención, visitas o violencia familiar, llame a la oficina de Wichita Falls al (940) 723-5542.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - Landlord-Tenant Line
records.description_en: A phone line for tenants with eviction and landlord problems in the North and West Texas counties LANWT serves.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income renters who live in a county LANWT serves.
records.how_to_apply: Call 855-548-8457, or apply online through LANWT.
records.notes: If you have an eviction hearing date, call right away. The line's own hours are not listed on the source. Legal Aid Line (1-888-529-5277) hours per LANWT's online intake page: Monday, Wednesday, Thursday 9 a.m.-6:30 p.m.; Tuesday 9 a.m.-4 p.m.
records.description_es: Una línea telefónica para inquilinos con problemas de desalojo o con el dueño, en los condados del norte y oeste de Texas que atiende LANWT.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inquilinos de bajos ingresos que viven en un condado que atiende LANWT.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 855-548-8457 o presente su solicitud en internet con LANWT.

records.name: TexasLawHelp.org
records.description_en: A free website with plain-language legal information, court forms, step-by-step guided forms, a legal aid directory, clinic listings, and free live chat with attorneys.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Free for anyone in Texas. Legal help through the site's chat is for income-eligible Texans.
records.how_to_apply: Go to TexasLawHelp.org to find forms and guides, use the Legal Help Directory to find legal aid near you, or use Live Chat.
records.hours: Online legal chat Monday-Thursday, 10 a.m.-2 p.m. (per TLSC)
records.notes: Topics include family law, divorce, custody, protective orders, criminal records, housing, and benefits. Chat hours are from tlsc.org.
records.description_es: Un sitio web gratis con información legal fácil de entender, formularios de la corte, formularios guiados paso a paso, un directorio de ayuda legal, lista de clínicas y chat en vivo gratis con abogados.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Gratis para cualquier persona en Texas. La ayuda legal por el chat del sitio es para tejanos que califican por sus ingresos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Entre a TexasLawHelp.org para encontrar formularios y guías, use el directorio de ayuda legal para encontrar ayuda cerca de usted, o use el chat en vivo.

records.name: TexasLawHelp Eviction Answer and Defense Guide
records.description_en: Free forms and step-by-step instructions to file an Answer to an eviction lawsuit, plus guides on negotiating with your landlord and appealing an eviction.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For any Texas tenant who has been sued for eviction or is at risk of eviction.
documents_needed: Eviction petition and citation from the court
records.how_to_apply: Open the guide, download the fillable Answer form, fill it out, file it with the justice court that issued your eviction citation (in person or at efiletexas.gov), and give a copy to the landlord or the landlord's lawyer. Go to your hearing. Your hearing can be as soon as 10 days after the landlord files.
records.notes: If the landlord filed a Motion for Summary Disposition, you must respond within 4 days. Related: negotiation guide https://texaslawhelp.org/guide/i-want-to-avoid-eviction-by-negotiating-with-my-landlord and appeal article https://texaslawhelp.org/article/appealing-an-eviction. For free lawyer help call your area's legal aid (TRLA, LSLA, or LANWT).
records.description_es: Formularios gratis e instrucciones paso a paso para presentar una Respuesta (Answer) a una demanda de desalojo. También hay guías para negociar con el dueño y apelar un desalojo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para cualquier inquilino en Texas que tiene una demanda de desalojo o está en riesgo de ser desalojado.
records.how_to_apply_es: Abra la guía, descargue el formulario de Respuesta (Answer), llénelo y preséntelo en la corte de paz (justice court) que emitió su citatorio de desalojo (en persona o en efiletexas.gov). Dé una copia al dueño o a su abogado. Vaya a su audiencia. La audiencia puede ser tan pronto como 10 días después de que el dueño presente la demanda.

records.name: Texas Veterans Legal Assistance Program
records.description_en: Free legal help for low-income veterans and their families with VA benefits, discharge upgrades, family law, housing, bankruptcy, record sealing, estate planning, and Social Security issues.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Texas residents who are veterans, or a veteran's spouse, surviving spouse, or dependent child, with household income at or below 200% of the federal poverty guidelines.
records.how_to_apply: Call 800-622-2520 and choose Option 2, or apply online at TexasLawHelp.org/intake.
records.notes: Press Option 2 for veterans. Spouses, surviving spouses, and dependents of veterans also qualify.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis para veteranos de bajos ingresos y sus familias con beneficios del VA, mejora de la baja militar, asuntos de familia, vivienda, bancarrota, sellar antecedentes, testamentos y asuntos del Seguro Social.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de Texas que son veteranos, o cónyuges, viudos o viudas, o hijos dependientes de un veterano, con ingresos del hogar iguales o menores al 200% de las guías federales de pobreza.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 800-622-2520 y elija la opción 2, o presente su solicitud en internet en TexasLawHelp.org/intake.

records.name: Legal Hotline for Texans (Senior and Medicare/Medicaid Line)
records.description_en: Free phone advice from attorneys about Medicaid, Medicare, and long-term care, and for people 60+ about wills, powers of attorney, Transfer on Death Deeds, debt collection, and consumer problems.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone can get advice on Medicaid, Medicare, and long-term care. For wills, estate planning, and consumer or debt issues you must be 60 or older and live in Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Call 800-622-2520 and choose Option 3, or apply online at TexasLawHelp.org/intake.
records.notes: Press Option 3. Advice only: attorneys cannot draft documents, negotiate, or go to court for you. Age 60+ applies only to estate planning and consumer topics.
records.description_es: Consejos gratis por teléfono con abogados sobre Medicaid, Medicare y cuidado a largo plazo. Para personas de 60 años o más, también sobre testamentos, poderes legales, escrituras de transferencia al fallecer, cobro de deudas y problemas como consumidor.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona puede recibir consejos sobre Medicaid, Medicare y cuidado a largo plazo. Para testamentos, planificación de herencias y problemas de deudas o como consumidor, debe tener 60 años o más y vivir en Texas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 800-622-2520 y elija la opción 3, o presente su solicitud en internet en TexasLawHelp.org/intake.

records.name: Family Helpline (CPS Legal Questions)
records.description_en: Talk for free with an experienced child welfare attorney about Child Protective Services (CPS) issues in Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: No requirements. Anyone with a question about Texas CPS can call.
records.how_to_apply: Call 844-888-6565 during helpline hours.
records.notes: For parents or relatives dealing with a CPS investigation or case.
records.description_es: Hable gratis con un abogado con experiencia en bienestar infantil sobre asuntos de Servicios de Protección Infantil (CPS) en Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: No hay requisitos. Cualquier persona con una pregunta sobre CPS en Texas puede llamar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 844-888-6565 en el horario de la línea de ayuda.

records.name: Texas Family Help Link
records.description_en: One online application that connects families with local legal aid and self-help resources for issues about children's safety, health, and stability.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Your legal issue must be related to the safety, health, or stability of children and youth.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the online application at TexasLawHelp.org/FHL to be connected with local legal aid or self-help resources.
records.description_es: Una sola solicitud en internet que conecta a las familias con ayuda legal local y recursos para ayudarse a sí mismas en asuntos de seguridad, salud y estabilidad de los niños.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Su problema legal debe tener que ver con la seguridad, la salud o la estabilidad de niños y jóvenes.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud en internet en TexasLawHelp.org/FHL para que lo conecten con ayuda legal local o recursos para ayudarse a sí mismo.

records.name: Texas Access - Access and Visitation Hotline and Parenting Order Legal Line
records.organization: Office of the Attorney General of Texas, Child Support Division
records.description_en: Free legal information about custody, visitation, and child support orders by phone, plus live chat with family law attorneys about parenting time.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Texas parents with questions about custody, visitation, or child support. For the attorney chat (Parenting Order Legal Line), noncustodial parents qualify; custodial parents must be at or below 125% of the federal poverty guidelines.
records.how_to_apply: Call the hotline at (866) 292-4636, or use live chat at txaccess.org during chat hours.
records.hours: Hotline Monday-Friday 1:00-5:00 p.m. CST; live chat Monday and Wednesday 1:00-5:00 p.m., Friday 1:00-3:00 p.m. CST
records.notes: The 125% FPL limit for custodial parents comes from the TLSC family page (https://www.tlsc.org/family) describing the Parenting Order Legal Line.
records.description_es: Información legal gratis por teléfono sobre custodia, visitas y órdenes de manutención de los hijos. También hay chat en vivo con abogados de familia sobre el tiempo con los hijos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para padres en Texas con preguntas sobre custodia, visitas o manutención de los hijos. Para el chat con abogados (Parenting Order Legal Line), los padres sin la custodia califican; los padres con la custodia deben tener ingresos iguales o menores al 125% de las guías federales de pobreza.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea al (866) 292-4636, o use el chat en vivo en txaccess.org en el horario del chat.

records.name: Lawyer Referral & Information Service (LRIS)
records.description_en: Refers you to a private lawyer near you. The first consultation of up to 30 minutes costs no more than $20.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to anyone in Texas who needs a lawyer. Useful if you do not qualify for free legal aid.
records.how_to_apply: Call (800) 252-9690. Staff will ask your county, legal issue, name, zip code, and phone, then give you a lawyer to call for an appointment.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8:30 a.m.-4:30 p.m. CST (closed legal holidays)
records.cost: Up to 30-minute consultation for no more than $20; later fees set with the lawyer
records.notes: Bexar, Dallas, Harris, Jefferson, Travis, and Tarrant counties have their own certified local referral services.
records.description_es: Le recomienda un abogado privado cerca de usted. La primera consulta, de hasta 30 minutos, cuesta no más de $20.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a cualquier persona en Texas que necesite un abogado. Es útil si no califica para ayuda legal gratis.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (800) 252-9690. Le preguntarán su condado, su problema legal, su nombre, código postal y teléfono. Luego le darán el nombre de un abogado para que usted lo llame y haga una cita.

records.name: Texas Lawyers for Texas Veterans (TLTV)
records.description_en: Free legal advice clinics across Texas where volunteer lawyers help veterans and their families with civil legal problems.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Texas veterans and their families who cannot afford a lawyer.
records.how_to_apply: Check the TLTV Legal Clinic Calendar on the State Bar website to find a clinic near you, or call the State Bar at 800-204-2222.
records.notes: 800-204-2222 is the State Bar main number, not a dedicated veterans line. Clinics are held in partnership with local bars and legal aid.
records.description_es: Clínicas gratis de consejos legales en todo Texas, donde abogados voluntarios ayudan a veteranos y sus familias con problemas legales civiles.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para veteranos de Texas y sus familias que no pueden pagar un abogado.
records.how_to_apply_es: Revise el calendario de clínicas legales de TLTV en el sitio web del State Bar para encontrar una clínica cerca de usted, o llame al State Bar al 800-204-2222.

records.name: Disability Rights Texas - Legal Advocacy
records.description_en: Texas's protection and advocacy agency. It gives legal help for disability discrimination and problems getting disability services, including education, jobs, health care, housing, transportation, and voting.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Texas residents with disabilities who face disability discrimination or have problems getting disability services. It only handles disability-related legal issues.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at intake.drtx.org any time, or call the intake line at 1-800-252-9108. Deaf callers can use video phone 1-866-362-2851 or 512-271-9391.
records.hours: Phone intake Monday-Thursday, 10 a.m.-12 p.m. and 1-3 p.m. Central
records.notes: Decision takes at least 10 business days after applying. Accommodation requests: info@drtx.org. Deaf callers can use video phone 1-866-362-2851 or 512-271-9391 during intake hours.
records.description_es: La agencia de protección y defensa de Texas para personas con discapacidad. Da ayuda legal en casos de discriminación por discapacidad y problemas para recibir servicios, incluyendo educación, empleo, salud, vivienda, transporte y votación.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de Texas con discapacidad que sufren discriminación por su discapacidad o tienen problemas para recibir servicios. Solo atiende asuntos legales relacionados con la discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en internet en intake.drtx.org a cualquier hora, o llame a la línea de admisión al 1-800-252-9108. Las personas sordas pueden usar videoteléfono al 1-866-362-2851 o al 512-271-9391.

records.name: Texas Disaster Legal Help
records.organization: Texas Disaster Legal Help (volunteer attorney network)
records.description_en: Free legal help and information for disaster survivors in Texas, with volunteer attorneys.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Texas affected by a disaster.
records.how_to_apply: Go to texasdisasterlegalhelp.org and fill out the Get Help intake form.
records.notes: No phone listed on the site. The Get Help intake form is hosted at tdlh.legalserver.org. In LANWT counties, disaster questions can also go to 817-339-5391.
records.description_es: Ayuda e información legal gratis para sobrevivientes de desastres en Texas, con abogados voluntarios.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en Texas afectadas por un desastre.
records.how_to_apply_es: Entre a texasdisasterlegalhelp.org y llene el formulario "Get Help".

records.name: RAICES Immigration Legal Services
records.organization: Refugee and Immigrant Center for Education and Legal Services (RAICES)
records.description_en: Low-cost (subsidized) immigration legal help, including deportation defense and asylum, family-based petitions, citizenship, and DACA and temporary status renewals.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For immigrants and refugees in Texas who need immigration legal help.
records.how_to_apply: Call 1-833-3-RAICES (1-833-372-4237) to set up a first consultation. Rural residents can call 1-800-490-2606.
records.notes: San Antonio headquarters address shown; call before visiting. Other offices: Austin (3000 S IH-35 #200), Corpus Christi (1801 S Alamida), Dallas-Fort Worth (1420 W Mockingbird Ln #840, Dallas), Houston (1900 St James Pl #450). Rural line 1-800-490-2606 is for survivors of crime, trafficking, or domestic violence in rural Texas. Hours not listed.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal de inmigración a bajo costo (subsidiada), incluyendo defensa contra la deportación y asilo, peticiones familiares, ciudadanía y renovaciones de DACA y estatus temporal.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inmigrantes y refugiados en Texas que necesitan ayuda legal de inmigración.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 1-833-3-RAICES (1-833-372-4237) para hacer una primera consulta. Si vive en una zona rural, puede llamar al 1-800-490-2606.

records.name: American Gateways - Austin Office
records.description_en: Free or low-cost immigration legal help for immigrants in Central Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For immigrants who meet the program's income guidelines and case priorities. Capacity for new clients is limited.
records.how_to_apply: Call (512) 478-0546 ext. 200 to request a legal screening appointment. By appointment only.
records.hours: Phone screening 2nd and 4th week of the month, Monday-Thursday, 9 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.notes: Dial ext. 200. Call until you reach a person; messages about applications are not returned. By appointment only. Capacity for new clients is limited.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal de inmigración gratis o a bajo costo para inmigrantes en el Centro de Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inmigrantes que cumplen con las guías de ingresos y las prioridades de casos del programa. Tienen poco espacio para clientes nuevos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (512) 478-0546, extensión 200, para pedir una cita de evaluación legal. Solo con cita.

records.name: American Gateways - San Antonio Office
records.description_en: Free or low-cost immigration legal help for immigrants in Central Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For immigrants who meet the program's income guidelines and case priorities. Capacity for new clients is limited.
records.how_to_apply: Call (210) 521-4768 ext. 232 to request a legal screening appointment. By appointment only.
records.notes: Dial ext. 232. You can leave a voicemail; you will hear within 30 days if a consultation can be scheduled. By appointment only. Capacity for new clients is limited.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal de inmigración gratis o a bajo costo para inmigrantes en el Centro de Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inmigrantes que cumplen con las guías de ingresos y las prioridades de casos del programa. Tienen poco espacio para clientes nuevos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (210) 521-4768, extensión 232, para pedir una cita de evaluación legal. Solo con cita.

records.name: American Gateways - Waco Office
records.description_en: Free or low-cost immigration legal help for immigrants in Central Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For immigrants who meet the program's income guidelines and case priorities. Capacity for new clients is limited.
records.how_to_apply: Call (210) 521-4768 ext. 232 to request a legal screening appointment. By appointment only.
records.notes: Dial ext. 232 (the Waco office uses the San Antonio phone line). Capacity for new clients is limited.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal de inmigración gratis o a bajo costo para inmigrantes en el Centro de Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inmigrantes que cumplen con las guías de ingresos y las prioridades de casos del programa. Tienen poco espacio para clientes nuevos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (210) 521-4768, extensión 232, para pedir una cita de evaluación legal. Solo con cita.

records.name: Tahirih Justice Center - Houston
records.description_en: Free, confidential immigration legal services and case management for immigrant survivors of gender-based violence such as domestic violence, sexual assault, forced marriage, and human trafficking.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For immigrant survivors of gender-based violence, such as domestic violence, sexual assault, forced marriage, female genital cutting, or human trafficking.
records.how_to_apply: Call the central intake line at 1-866-575-0071 on weekdays, or contact the Houston office at 713-496-0100.
records.notes: Houston office phone: 713-496-0100, email houston@tahirih.org. Street address not published. Exact service counties not stated on the source.
records.description_es: Servicios legales de inmigración y apoyo con su caso, gratis y confidenciales, para inmigrantes sobrevivientes de violencia de género, como violencia doméstica, agresión sexual, matrimonio forzado y trata de personas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inmigrantes sobrevivientes de violencia de género, como violencia doméstica, agresión sexual, matrimonio forzado, mutilación genital femenina o trata de personas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea central de admisión al 1-866-575-0071 de lunes a viernes, o comuníquese con la oficina de Houston al 713-496-0100.

records.name: Las Americas Immigrant Advocacy Center
records.description_en: Immigration legal services and human rights advocacy for low-income immigrants in the El Paso border region.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income immigrants.
records.how_to_apply: Call (915) 544-5126 or see the Community Resources page on the website.
records.notes: Cost and hours not listed on the site. Note the website is las-americas.org (with a hyphen).
records.description_es: Servicios legales de inmigración y defensa de los derechos humanos para inmigrantes de bajos ingresos en la región fronteriza de El Paso.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inmigrantes de bajos ingresos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (915) 544-5126 o vea la página de recursos comunitarios en el sitio web.

records.name: Estrella del Paso (formerly Diocesan Migrant & Refugee Services)
records.organization: Estrella del Paso, a ministry of the Catholic Diocese of El Paso
records.description_en: Free immigration consultations, legal representation, and community education for immigrants in West Texas and New Mexico.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For immigrants in West Texas and New Mexico. A first consultation checks whether you qualify for free services.
records.how_to_apply: Call 915-532-3975 or visit the office to schedule an initial consultation.
records.cost: Mostly free (99% of services were free in 2025); some services have fees
records.notes: Serves West Texas and New Mexico; only El Paso County confirmed by office location. Unaccompanied Children's Program has closed. Hours not listed.
records.description_es: Consultas de inmigración gratis, representación legal y educación comunitaria para inmigrantes en el oeste de Texas y Nuevo México.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inmigrantes en el oeste de Texas y Nuevo México. En la primera consulta revisan si usted califica para servicios gratis.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 915-532-3975 o visite la oficina para hacer una cita de consulta inicial.

records.name: Immigration Legal Services - Catholic Charities Dallas
records.description_en: Immigration legal services for people in the Dallas and North Texas area.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For immigrants in the Dallas/North Texas area. Call to ask about eligibility and fees.
records.how_to_apply: Call the helpline at 866-223-7500 or visit the Central Service Center.
records.notes: The website confirms an Immigration Legal Services program, but fees, eligibility, and exact counties are not listed; only Dallas County is confirmed by office location. Hours shown are for the Central Service Center.
records.description_es: Servicios legales de inmigración para personas en Dallas y el norte de Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inmigrantes en Dallas y el norte de Texas. Llame para preguntar si califica y cuánto cuesta.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de ayuda al 866-223-7500 o visite el Centro de Servicio Central.

records.name: Houston Volunteer Lawyers
records.description_en: Free volunteer lawyers for non-criminal problems such as family law, housing, wills and estates, guardianship, veterans issues, taxes, wage claims, and citizenship applications.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For eligible low-income residents of the Greater Houston area. Non-criminal cases only.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the online questionnaire at legalhelphouston.org, call 713-228-0735, or email info@hvlp.org.
records.notes: Also serves 'surrounding areas' of Harris County (not listed). Separate intake forms for citizenship and wage claims.
records.description_es: Abogados voluntarios gratis para problemas no penales, como asuntos de familia, vivienda, testamentos y herencias, tutela, asuntos de veteranos, impuestos, reclamos de salario y solicitudes de ciudadanía.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de bajos ingresos del área de Houston que califiquen. Solo casos no penales.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene el cuestionario en internet en legalhelphouston.org, llame al 713-228-0735 o escriba a info@hvlp.org.

records.name: Dallas Volunteer Attorney Program (DVAP)
records.description_en: Free legal clinics where volunteer lawyers help low-income Dallas County residents with civil legal problems. There is also a clinic for veterans.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income Dallas County residents who meet program guidelines. No criminal cases, tickets, or personal injury cases.
documents_needed: Copies of your court papers if you have been sued
records.how_to_apply: Go to one of DVAP's legal clinics to apply. Bring your legal documents. Call 214-243-2236 for clinic information.
records.notes: Clinic sites: MLK Community Center (2922 Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd), West Dallas Multipurpose Center (2828 Fish Trap Rd), Grace United Methodist Church (4105 Junius St), and a Veterans Clinic at the VA Medical Center (4500 S. Lancaster Rd). Check clinic schedules before going.
records.description_es: Clínicas legales gratis donde abogados voluntarios ayudan a residentes de bajos ingresos del condado de Dallas con problemas legales civiles. También hay una clínica para veteranos.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes de bajos ingresos del condado de Dallas que cumplan con las reglas del programa. No atienden casos penales, multas ni casos de lesiones personales.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a una de las clínicas legales de DVAP para solicitar ayuda. Lleve sus papeles legales. Llame al 214-243-2236 para información sobre las clínicas.

records.name: Volunteer Legal Services of Central Texas (VLS)
records.organization: Volunteer Legal Services of Central Texas
records.description_en: Free legal advice from volunteer attorneys for people in the Austin area.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Based on household income, assets, where you live, the type of legal problem, and how many cases VLS can take.
records.how_to_apply: Call (512) 476-5550 or visit vlsoct.org/get-help (English and Spanish).
records.notes: Exact service counties not listed on the site; Travis County assumed from Austin location. Confirm service area when calling.
records.description_es: Consejos legales gratis de abogados voluntarios para personas en el área de Austin.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Depende de los ingresos del hogar, sus bienes, dónde vive, el tipo de problema legal y cuántos casos puede aceptar VLS.
